Is there a way to get a call to a LEXPR to compile
as a call to an EXPR? In the case of the
macsyma MFORMAT and MERROR functions, which are both
lexprs, the overhead of going through the UUO handler
for these is small compared with the time spent inside them,
also, the space save by using the SUBR calling convention
of the the LSUBR one is significant.
